== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|[[House]] Gray is a newly established organization formed following the [[destruction]] of previous houses during the [[Dread War]]. It serves as a refuge for various groups, including the [[Shen tribe]] and several Underlord{{!}}Underlords from across [[Rosegold]]. The house offers protection through the guidance of a [[Sage]], specifically [[Valketh]], who was formerly associated with [[House Wylan]]. While many leaders from different groups have already pledged their allegiance to this new house, the members' loyalty is often rooted in respect for individual skill rather than personal friendship. [[House]] Gray exists in a state of tension with the Arelius family{{!}}Arelius clan, despite the latter providing resources and safety. Within the house, Reigan Shen{{!}}Reigan serves as a leader who trains against older Underlord{{!}}Underlords to prepare for upcoming events.}}

== Threshold: Stories from Cradle ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|[[House]] Gray is a noble house formed from the scattered remnants of destroyed families and factions. Led by a [[Sage]], this new group includes [[Reigan Shen]], who intends to guide the house to victory in the Uncrowned King Tournament{{!}}Uncrowned King tournament. The house provides support to Tiberian Arelius{{!}}Tiberian, and [[Valketh]] has promised that the house will be in debt to Reigan Shen{{!}}Reigan should he succeed in his goal.}}
